description: Community-Based Water Resiliency (CBWR) Guide is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EPA Office of Ground Water and Drinking Water, Water Security Division. The Community-Based Water Resiliency (CBWR) Guide, available from the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, provides a structured method for assessing your community's current resiliency to water service interruptions. It also offers information about tools and resources that can be used to enhance resiliency. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Water Quality. Assets: Water Infrastructure – Drinking Water, Water Infrastructure – General, Water Infrastructure – Wastewater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
